rollup.forecast.label: Revenue forecast and pipeline by vertical

rollup.monthly.label: Monthly revenue, actual and forecast against budget

engineer.sales.label: Sales performance by product line, one engineer

engineer.targets.label: Business targets by product line, one engineer

ytdRevenue.text: Invoiced revenue for January to August 2026, AED thousands, each product line counted once in its home vertical.

ytdBudget.text: The approved 2026 budget phased by month and summed for the same 8 months.

variance.text: Actual less budget for the same period, AED thousands. Negative is below budget and is shown in red.

gmPct.text: Gross margin divided by revenue for the same period.

openOrders.text: Confirmed customer orders on the system that are not yet invoiced. Not revenue.

expectedOrders.text: Opportunities the engineer rates above 90 percent probability, plus letters of intent. Not secured business and not revenue.

fyForecast.text: YTD actual revenue plus the engineer forecasts for September 2026 and October to December 2026.

fyBudget.text: The approved 2026 revenue budget for the full year.

nearMonth.text: The engineer forecast for September 2026, the first open month.

restOfYear.text: The engineer forecast for October to December 2026.

priorYear.text: Full-year 2025 actual revenue and gross margin.

yoy.text: FY 2026 forecast against FY 2025 actual, percent.

plColumns.text: YTD is January to August 2026 actual. FY forecast is the full year, with costs annualised from the elapsed months. FY budget is the approved full-year budget. No phased profit budget exists for the elapsed months, so profit is compared full year to full year only.

buProfitability.text: Gross margin less salary, warehouse cost, warehouse salaries and common admin. The rung a vertical head controls.

buNetProfit.text: BU profitability less provisions, inter-company interest and corporate overhead.

roiYtd.text: YTD gross margin divided by the engineer's cost to employ for the same 8 months. A multiple, not a percentage.

roiBudget.text: FY budget gross margin divided by annual cost to employ.

roiForecast.text: FY forecast gross margin divided by annual cost to employ.

roiPriorYear.text: FY 2025 gross margin divided by FY 2025 cost to employ.

directContribution.text: YTD gross margin less YTD cost to employ. Not a profit and loss: warehouse, admin, provisions and group charges are booked at the vertical, not the person.

totalOutstanding.text: All unpaid invoices at August 2026 month end, whatever their age.

netToCollect.text: Total outstanding less the provision. The balance the business still expects to collect. It is not a cash forecast and carries no date.

provisionReceivable.text: Half of balances aged 1 to 2 years, all of balances aged over 2 years, and a quarter of a disputed balance aged 91 to 365 days.

agingBuckets.text: Days since the invoice date, whatever the payment terms. A balance can sit in 31 to 90 days and still be within terms.

pastDue.text: Invoices older than the customer’s payment terms, from invoice date plus terms. This is the contractual measure of lateness.

notYetDue.text: Invoices inside the customer’s payment terms.

dispute.text: The engineer has flagged the balance as disputed by the customer.

reasons.text: Each customer balance carries one reason: internal group companies; follow-up, no timeline or no response; disputes and not yet due. The third is shown split into disputed balances and balances with nothing past due. Reasons partition total outstanding.

monthOnMonth.text: Net to collect at August 2026 month end against July 2026 month end.

unbilled.text: Work delivered and not yet invoiced, by project. The three-month trend shows two months ago, last month and this month.

unbilledAging.text: Days since delivery, in the eight bands used by the reference pack.

bridge.text: Previous month, plus projects new this month, less projects cleared by invoicing, plus or less changes on ongoing projects, equals current month.

inventoryBands.text: Stock value at cost by age since receipt: under 1 year, 1 to 2, 2 to 3, over 3 years. The bands sum to total stock.

inventoryProvision.text: Half of stock aged 2 to 3 years plus all stock over 3 years.

mappedLpo.text: Stock already allocated to a customer order. Free stock is total stock less this.

freeStockOverOneYear.text: Unallocated stock older than a year: the part of inventory most at risk.

nonMoving.text: Stock with no movement in the year, or superseded. A subset of the over-3-year band.

inTransit.text: Goods paid for or committed and not yet received, with the expected arrival date. Not included in stock.

target.text: The full-year 2026 target for the product line, equal to its approved budget.

aspiration.text: The stretch figure agreed with the vertical head.

budgetToDate.text: The target phased by month and summed for January to August 2026. Achieved is compared with this, not with the full-year target.

attributedTotal.text: This vertical’s own engineers only. This is the figure every summary table carries.

sheetTotal.text: Every row on this sheet, including product lines sold by other verticals’ engineers. Adding sheet totals across verticals would double count them.

revenueShare.text: Share of netted division forecast revenue, allocated to one decimal so the rows sum to exactly 100.0.

workingCapital.text: Net receivables plus unbilled plus stock at cost. Goods in transit are shown beside it and not added.

production.text: Factory output by month: quantity delivered, its invoiced value, and the material and labour cost booked. Value ties to the vertical’s monthly revenue.

rows.currentRemark: Intercompany offset agreed with group finance, posting in September
